# Prince Raj — geetprince.me

> Backend and Full Stack Software Engineer specializing in scalable architecture and modern web experiences. Based in Greater Noida, India.

## Featured Projects

- **Verse** — Collaborative music streaming Android app with real-time Jam Sessions via Firebase Realtime Database, ExoPlayer media playback, and Spring Boot REST API backend. Built with Kotlin, MVVM, Material Design. Live: https://verse.geetprince.me/
- **Progex** — Competitive programming analytics and social platform. Built with Flask (Python), Firebase, HTML/CSS/JavaScript. Aggregates LeetCode/Codeforces stats.
